headline: US bitcoin funds turned negative for 2026 after their worst week since June, while Binance's finance chief steps down nine days after the exchange's record hack.

market.asOf: Read from CoinGecko at about 03:55 UTC Sun 8 Nov (10:55 Bangkok). 24h changes are left blank because CoinGecko's pages showed conflicting figures. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme Fear: the alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index read 25 (Extreme Fear) on Sun 8 Nov, after 28 yesterday and 30 a week ago.

stories.title: US bitcoin funds turn negative for 2026 after a $1.28B outflow week
stories.summary: Investors pulled $1.28 billion from US spot bitcoin ETFs in the week of 2-6 November, the worst week since late June. That wiped out the year's gains: the funds are now net sellers for 2026. Bitcoin itself was flat over the weekend near $75,700.
points: Net flows by day: Mon -$398.6M, Tue -$115.6M, Wed +$74.6M, Thu -$430.2M, Fri -$411.9M, per The Block.
The 12 funds are now about -$914.1M for 2026, after starting the week about +$368M, per The Block.
BlackRock's IBIT lost $1.21B on the week, while Fidelity's FBTC took in $93.1M, per crypto.news.
Ether ETFs lost $365.2M on the week, per crypto.news.
Bitcoin was about $75,694 at 03:55 UTC Sunday (10:55 Bangkok), per CoinGecko.

sources.label: The Block: bitcoin ETFs flip negative for 2026
crypto.news: bitcoin and ether ETF weekly outflows

stories.title: Binance's finance chief steps down nine days after the record hack
stories.summary: Binance co-CEO Yi He said CFO Kaiser Ng is leaving to pursue a new venture, with Justin Yek taking over. She said the handover was planned about six months ago, before the hack. Meanwhile the hackers keep swapping stolen tokens into bitcoin.
points: Ng has been CFO since January 2022; Yek was previously VP of finance at Airwallex, per The Block.
The 29 Oct breach totalled $6.43B, per The Block; TechCrunch puts it at $6.3B.
About $124M of stolen altcoins has been swapped into bitcoin, per The Block's report on Elliptic's tracking.
Binance plans to reopen withdrawals for HYPE, INJ, APT, PLASMA, NEAR and LTC by the end of next week, per The Block.
Users pulled a net $3.6B in the first hours after withdrawals were unfrozen, per TechCrunch.

stories.title: MEXC says withdrawals are orderly after the US Treasury cut-off order
stories.summary: The US Treasury's financial-crimes unit, FinCEN, named exchange MEXC a primary money laundering concern and ordered US banks and payment firms to stop handling its transfers. MEXC's CEO says withdrawals are running smoothly, but some USDT withdrawal networks were down on Saturday.
points: The order takes effect 30 days after it is published in the Federal Register, per FinanceFeeds.
FinCEN alleges at least $16.7B of suspected illicit transactions from May 2021 to May 2026, per FinanceFeeds; The Block puts it at about $16B.
Only 6 of 18 USDT withdrawal networks were available on 7 Nov, per tracker Cexorer via FinanceFeeds.
CEO Vugar Usi said deposits and withdrawals were running smoothly, with withdrawal volume up but orderly, per ChainCatcher.

briefs.title: Keplr update on the social-login flaw
briefs.summary: Keplr says a Web3Auth flaw leaked private keys for some Google/Apple-login wallets; seed-phrase and hardware wallets are not affected, and users should ignore 'recovery' messages, per ChainCatcher.

briefs.title: Ex-FBI agent pleads guilty to crypto theft
briefs.summary: Patrick Yaroch pleaded guilty to stealing about $2.47M in crypto from wallets tied to 35 FBI investigations; sentencing is set for 4 March 2027, per The Block.

briefs.title: Mercado Bitcoin starts a phased reopening Monday
briefs.summary: Brazil's Mercado Bitcoin reopens view-only first, with withdrawals and trading still suspended; blockchain analysts estimate more than $46M was stolen and the company says more than $15M has been frozen, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Travel-rule tightening withdrawn
briefs.summary: A plan to cut the cross-border recordkeeping threshold from $3,000 to $250 was withdrawn, effective 9 Nov, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Crypto-in-401(k) rule still at the White House
briefs.summary: The Labor Department's proposed rule on alternative assets, including crypto, in retirement plans was filed for White House review on 5 Nov, per The Block.

briefs.title: Crypto policy after the midterms
briefs.summary: House Democrats reportedly plan a broader crypto market-structure bill with more SEC oversight next Congress, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Zcash upgrade cuts block time
briefs.summary: Zcash's NU7 upgrade activated on 6 Nov, cutting block time from 75 to 25 seconds, per crypto.news.
